findings.title: Frozen SHA-256 and Git blob identities hold
findings.detail: 73/73 inputs.json files match frozen sandbox SHA-256. No extra sandbox files. All 20 static-closure files match manifest SHA-256, byte length, and Git blob SHA-1 recomputed as sha1(blob SP len NUL bytes). The three example files match example-inputs.json the same way. Original-13 hashes are unchanged from the prior 13-file pin. LICENSE is Apache-2.0. Both supplement acceptance fields are false. Live Moriarty git show was not repeated.

findings.title: 20-file AST closure from original 13 roots has 40 edges and no unresolved target
findings.detail: Roots are the prior 13 files. Added files are frontend.ts, registered-bounds.ts, parser.ts, checker.ts, validate.ts, diagnostics.ts, and spec/bounds.json. Edges: 37 pinned_relative, 3 node_builtin_host_dependency (node:fs, node:crypto, node:util). Every pinned_relative target exists in the pin. Scanner scope is static import/export, literal dynamic import/require, and new URL. simulate.mjs is outside that walk and is bound separately by example-inputs.json together with loan.mori and swap.mori.

findings.title: Loan settle closes the episode and leaves agreement Outstanding
findings.detail: Captured and replayed loan settle after-state: episodeStatus Closed, agreementStatus Outstanding, kind Simulation. The supplement does not relabel this as settled ledger or accepted proof. Swap close is Closed / NoOutstanding. This remains local simulation.

findings.title: Generated checkedAdd rejects sums above 2^128-1 at this compiler pin
findings.detail: Source SHA-256 b2969d0bc346fa93d88546578c9f9d29f1b74d7bc3f88f2e04709fa0932d9415 compiled under compiler 0.31.1 / language 0.23.0 / runtime 0.16.0 --skip-zk. execve.log binds compactc.bin. Generated _checkedAdd_0 adds then throws CompactError if the sum is greater than 340282366920938463463374607431768211455n. Private copy of compiled/ and probe.mjs byte-matched. node_modules symlink targeted the stated read-only runtime tree. Unchanged probe: 0+0, max+0, (max-1)+1 exact; max+1 and max+max CompactError cast refusals. Replay stdout SHA-256 2ef2229921535d031ea72a77d934ddaae6fc1284f85dd94de885b4f66867ae9c matches. No new compile.

findings.title: Pure-circuit compile produced no ZKIR, key, or proof artifacts
findings.detail: compiled/ contains only compiler/contract-info.json and contract/index.js, index.d.ts, index.js.map. contract-info.json marks checkedAdd, checkedSub, checkedMul, and checkedDiv pure true and proof false. compiled-manifest.json keys_generated, proofs_generated, and zkir_artifacts_present are false. Generated JS contains partialProofData scaffolding objects, not prover/verifier files. This source exported pure circuits.

findings.title: The two named prior gaps are resolved for the stated bounded scope
findings.detail: Prior source-readiness finding P31-UNPINNED-COMPILE (frontend.ts and registered-bounds.ts outside the 13-file pin) is closed for these examples by the 20-file AST pin plus the enumerated simulate/loan/swap inputs. Prior finding P31-COMPACT-ADD-CAST (checkedAdd as Uint<128> unobserved) is closed for five direct pureCircuits.checkedAdd calls at this compiler/runtime pin. Neither finding is closed as accepted readiness, adapter implementation, or a correspondence theorem.

findings.title: Supplements do not accept readiness, adapters, P31, or remaining pipeline
findings.detail: Both records set acceptance false. They do not claim DeFiKernel adapters, Lean correspondence, universal Compact arithmetic, ZKIR soundness, accepted P20 certificate consumption, or whole-program completion. Static closure does not prove all runtime filesystem access is closed. numeric-profile.json remains proposed-not-frozen. K remains a two-balance projection. Those limits are already stated. This audit does not invent extra gates for them.
